title: Spartak make history: Subotica club crowned Serbian champions for the first time
description: Spartak Office Shoes are champions of Serbia for the first time in their history, edging FMP 76-73 in an overtime thriller to complete one of the most remarkable runs in the modern Serbian game a title series featuring neither Crvena Zvezda nor Partizan. The Subotica side, who had already stunned Crvena Zvezda in the semifinals, kept their nerve in a tense, see-sawing final. Spartak controlled the early going, leading 24-19 after the first quarter and pushing the advantage through a strong third (22-16) to take command. But FMP refused to fold, storming back with an 18-5 fourth quarter to force overtime at 68-68. In the extra period, Spartak outscored FMP 8-5 to seal the historic championship.
imageCaption: Spartak Subotica clinch historic first title in Serbia (Photo: KK Spartak)
